observations: AgentRuntime._complete and AgentModelBridge.complete independently cap generation at 4096.

The query and recovery controllers replace ModelDispatchAdapter.inner only. Its outer chat method also clamps max_tokens to the isolated business fixture policy. A catalog-only planner-policy wrapper is therefore insufficient.
Any execution-policy mapping must retain fresh source revision, permission binding, quota and concurrency admission. Do not bypass ModelDispatchAdapter to obtain a larger generation allowance.
Keep business identities and business readback facts distinct from the actual planner policy; record the mapping explicitly for candidate and reference.
Reserve storage for bounded private continuation before inference. Review both _reserve_output and initial dispatch/reconciliation reservations.
Raw response overflow currently occurs before extracting usage. Rejections must preserve available sanitized counters without exporting response text or private reasoning.
Reference documents dispatch currently ignores the worker's requested max_output_tokens. Honor valid lower requests without allowing higher requests to exceed the shared ceiling.
Source policy provenance must use an explicit credential-free whitelist, not a digest of a secret-bearing source record.
